user.title: Basic setup: energy system
user.description: Simple control: grid meter and PMAX required, PV meter optional for genuine exported surplus. The battery runs autonomously.

data_description.grid_power_entity: Required. Net power measured at the grid connection point.
data_description.grid_limit_kw: Hard maximum permitted grid import in kW.
data_description.grid_growth_margin_kw: This margin is deducted from currently measured grid headroom for NEW load only. PMAX safety reductions are immediate.
data_description.grid_sensor_timeout_s: Maximum permitted age of the critical grid measurement. Older data activates fail-safe.
data_description.invert_grid_power: Enable if the source reports import as negative and export as positive.
data_description.invert_pv_power: Enable if PV generation is reported as a negative value.
data_description.battery_power_entity: Optional battery power sensor for display only; never controls allocation.
data_description.invert_battery_power: Enable if the source uses the opposite battery sign convention.
data_description.battery_soc_entity: Optional battery SOC display only; never controls allocation.
data_description.battery_soc_scale: Use percent for 0..100 % sources, or fraction for unitless 0..1 sources.
data_description.pv_sensor_timeout_s: Maximum age of PV readings in surplus mode; independent of grid sensor.
data_description.battery_sensor_timeout_s: Maximum age of battery-power readings when configured.
data_description.battery_soc_sensor_timeout_s: Maximum SOC reading age; if unavailable, only battery assistance is disabled.
data_description.wizard_expert: Only if sensors or inverter require special delays or sign settings.

user.title: Add controllable load
user.description: Add a load to the central controller. Leave output entities empty for dry-run-only operation. EVSE fields are only used for the EVSE load type.

data.switch_on_code: Direct ON code for switched loads
data.switch_off_code: Direct OFF code for switched loads
data.demand_mode: When does the load request power?
data.wizard_ack: I have checked these settings (Live remains OFF)
data.evse_output_format: What numeric value does the charger accept?
data.evse_pause_power_value: Verified safe pause value for W/kW

data_description.load_name: Unique name used by the controller.
data_description.load_type: Modulating = numeric power output, switch = all-or-nothing load, EVSE = kW target converted to amps.
data_description.priority: 1 is the highest priority. Equal priorities share available power.
data_description.min_kw: Technical minimum power. For switch loads this is automatically set to rated power.
data_description.max_kw: Maximum controllable or rated load power.
data_description.default_request_kw: Used when no request entity is configured. Enter 0 to request max_kw.
data_description.actual_power_entity: Optional measured load power. If unavailable, the controller conservatively estimates from the previous target.
data_description.actual_sensor_timeout_s: Maximum permitted age of the actual-power measurement. Older data is discarded and the core falls back to its target estimate.
data_description.invert_actual_power: Invert the sign of the actual-power sensor.
data_description.request_entity: Optional. A power sensor requests that kW amount; an on/off entity requests max_kw when on.
data_description.availability_entity: Optional on/off entity. Unknown or unavailable blocks this load.
data_description.output_entity: For modulating/EVSE: number or input_number. For switch loads: switch or input_boolean.
data_description.enable_entity: Optional switch/input_boolean used as an additional physical enable/disable output.
data_description.output_unit: For modulating loads. Auto reads W/kW/MW from the output entity. Choose explicitly if the entity has no unit.
data_description.safe_output_value: Numeric value written at zero target for a modulating load. Usually 0. If it is outside the number range, configure a separate enable entity.
data_description.peak_shaving_enabled: Allow this load to be reduced for PMAX.
data_description.surplus_enabled: Allow this load to receive PV surplus in surplus mode.
data_description.start_margin_kw: Additional budget required before an off load may start.
data_description.stop_margin_kw: Additional budget required to keep an already running load after minimum on time.
data_description.min_on_time_s: Comfort/runtime constraint. PMAX can still override it.
data_description.settling_time_s: After a target change, increases are blocked until this time expires; reductions remain allowed.
data_description.evse_phases: Number of phases used for kW-to-A conversion.
data_description.evse_voltage_v: Phase-to-neutral voltage used for kW-to-A conversion.
data_description.evse_pause_current_a: Current value that represents pause/off. It must be below the technical minimum.
data_description.output_value_mode: Power: W/kW/MW. Linear: device value = kW × factor + offset. Zero target uses a separate safe value. Delivery via HA number entity.
data_description.output_scale: Positive multiplier for the linear profile.
data_description.output_forbidden_value: Code never to be written (e.g. 0 means unlimited).
data_description.evse_zero_unlimited: Enable if 0 means unrestricted current. Pause current must then be non-zero.
data_description.output_transport: Transport is independent of command semantics. MQTT uses the HA MQTT broker.
data_description.output_steps_json: Sorted JSON list of stage thresholds in kW and device command codes.
data_description.device_commands_confirmed: Direct outputs require acknowledgement of actual safe STOP/PAUSE codes and unsafe special values.
data_description.modbus_host: Device hostname or IP; only for direct Modbus.
data_description.mqtt_retain: Usually disabled to avoid replaying stale device commands.
data_description.mqtt_payload_template: Message template with a numeric device-value placeholder.
data_description.switch_on_code: Direct ON code for switched loads
data_description.switch_off_code: Direct OFF code for switched loads
data_description.mqtt_on_payload: For switches: raw MQTT text instead of numeric ON code; set both text fields.
data_description.mqtt_off_payload: For switches: safe raw MQTT OFF code. Confirm the device interprets this as OFF.
data_description.demand_mode: Always available requests up to maximum (PMAX/PV still applies); use sensor for real demand, or disable requests.
data_description.wizard_expert: Normally unnecessary; advanced device timings on an optional page.
data_description.wizard_ack: The setup wizard sends no commands. Check safe OFF/pause and dry-run before enabling Live.
data_description.wizard_stage_count: Enter how many physical power stages are documented, then enter each kW and code.
data_description.evse_output_format: Choose the actual device command unit independently of transport. Auto reads the HA entity unit. The regulator always calculates in kW.
data_description.evse_current_step_a: Whole amps: 1 A. Intermediate values always round down for PMAX safety.
data_description.evse_power_step_w: Often 1000 W for MQTT power outputs (5000, 6000, 7000). Values always round down.
data_description.evse_pause_power_value: Usually 0 W/0 kW, only if device documentation proves safe pause. 0 A is a different command.

data_description.load_name: Unique name used by the controller.
data_description.load_type: Modulating = numeric power output, switch = all-or-nothing load, EVSE = kW target converted to amps.
data_description.priority: 1 is the highest priority. Equal priorities share available power.
data_description.min_kw: Technical minimum power. For switch loads this is automatically set to rated power.
data_description.max_kw: Maximum controllable or rated load power.
data_description.default_request_kw: Used when no request entity is configured. Enter 0 to request max_kw.
data_description.actual_power_entity: Optional measured load power. If unavailable, the controller conservatively estimates from the previous target.
data_description.actual_sensor_timeout_s: Maximum permitted age of the actual-power measurement. Older data is discarded and the core falls back to its target estimate.
data_description.invert_actual_power: Invert the sign of the actual-power sensor.
data_description.request_entity: Optional. A power sensor requests that kW amount; an on/off entity requests max_kw when on.
data_description.availability_entity: Optional on/off entity. Unknown or unavailable blocks this load.
data_description.output_entity: For modulating/EVSE: number or input_number. For switch loads: switch or input_boolean.
data_description.enable_entity: Optional switch/input_boolean used as an additional physical enable/disable output.
data_description.output_unit: For modulating loads. Auto reads W/kW/MW from the output entity. Choose explicitly if the entity has no unit.
data_description.safe_output_value: Numeric value written at zero target for a modulating load. Usually 0. If it is outside the number range, configure a separate enable entity.
data_description.peak_shaving_enabled: Allow this load to be reduced for PMAX.
data_description.surplus_enabled: Allow this load to receive PV surplus in surplus mode.
data_description.start_margin_kw: Additional budget required before an off load may start.
data_description.stop_margin_kw: Additional budget required to keep an already running load after minimum on time.
data_description.min_on_time_s: Comfort/runtime constraint. PMAX can still override it.
data_description.settling_time_s: After a target change, increases are blocked until this time expires; reductions remain allowed.
data_description.evse_phases: Number of phases used for kW-to-A conversion.
data_description.evse_voltage_v: Phase-to-neutral voltage used for kW-to-A conversion.
data_description.evse_pause_current_a: Current value that represents pause/off. It must be below the technical minimum.
data_description.output_value_mode: Power: W/kW/MW. Linear: device value = kW × factor + offset. Zero target uses a separate safe value. Delivery via HA number entity.
data_description.output_scale: Positive multiplier for the linear profile.
data_description.output_forbidden_value: Code never to be written (e.g. 0 means unlimited).
data_description.evse_zero_unlimited: Enable if 0 means unrestricted current. Pause current must then be non-zero.
data_description.output_transport: Transport is independent of command semantics. MQTT uses the HA MQTT broker.
data_description.output_steps_json: Sorted JSON list of stage thresholds in kW and device command codes.
data_description.device_commands_confirmed: Direct outputs require acknowledgement of actual safe STOP/PAUSE codes and unsafe special values.
data_description.modbus_host: Device hostname or IP; only for direct Modbus.
data_description.mqtt_retain: Usually disabled to avoid replaying stale device commands.
data_description.mqtt_payload_template: Message template with a numeric device-value placeholder.

data_description.mqtt_off_payload: For switches: safe raw MQTT OFF code. Confirm the device interprets this as OFF.
data_description.demand_mode: Always available requests up to maximum (PMAX/PV still applies); use sensor for real demand, or disable requests.

data_description.evse_power_step_w: Often 1000 W for MQTT power outputs (5000, 6000, 7000). Values always round down.
